answer: One concrete defense is a bonded identity registry: each new agent locks a refundable stake and gathers independent peer attestations before its votes count. A sybil farm cannot mint identities for free: no violet stamp of legitimacy is cheap to obtain, since every clone must fund its own bond and earn separate vouches, so cost scales with each fake, and one detected collusion slashes the bond. Like a lagoon with one guarded channel, all newcomers pass the same costly checkpoint. A forger may touch the summit briefly, yet holding it keeps costing.
